integration_policy.principle: Reuse capabilities through typed interfaces; do not vendor whole third-party applications into the core.
integration_policy.security: External credentials, browser sessions, and computer-use environments stay isolated behind explicit capability gates.

modules.integration: sandboxed click/type/app-launch capability with explicit action policy and audit trail
local inference provider with Android/desktop capability discovery and model lifecycle telemetry
Anthropic-compatible gateway contract; provider/model catalog; fallback routing; health and quota telemetry
paper -> dataset -> experiment -> result -> evidence graph pipeline
modules.note: Upstream repository is archived; reuse architecture ideas rather than depend on it.

modules.integration: offline inspection of rendered pages and underlying text layers; produce evidence artifacts for redaction-integrity checks
modules.security: read-only audit by default; never mutate source documents

modules.integration: market/economic data adapters, research workspace, portfolio/watchlist evidence feeds
strategy/library registry feeding research discovery, backtest candidates, risk/metrics/tool selection and evidence-linked experiments

modules.role: screen capture and polished demo output
modules.integration: capture -> annotate -> export -> attach artifact to run/evidence graph
modules.note: Upstream repository is archived; use the maintained successor or treat the original as an implementation reference.

modules.integration: document ingestion, question answering, quizzes, visual explanations, deep research tasks
topic -> script -> visual assets -> voice -> edit -> artifact/evidence record
OpenAI/Claude-compatible request normalization only where an authorized provider endpoint exists
modules.note: Upstream repository is archived; do not build account scraping or credential rotation into MindCloud.

modules.integration: isolated investigation adapter for heterogeneous-data ingestion, entity resolution, evidence-backed findings and graph artifacts; findings enter EvidenceGraph before promotion
modules.security: no unrestricted shell/web credentials; execution and workspace remain isolated; source evidence is immutable/read-only by default

modules.integration: read-only sensor adapter producing typed detections/range/Doppler/tracking evidence; no direct actuator authority; hardware domain isolated from MindCore
modules.security: hardware/FPGA execution isolated; sensor output requires Evidence validation and promotion gate

modules.integration: optional GPU compute/visualization capability for browser and headless Node; deterministic mock path used for CI and evidence-safe tests; documentation/examples discovered through agent-facing interfaces
modules.security: no credential access; GPU workloads sandboxed; prefer mock/headless validation before browser runtime promotion

modules.role: multi-agent execution orchestrator and worktree workspace
modules.integration: typed adapter for agent dispatch, isolated git worktrees, execution receipts, supervised task coordination and operator-visible workspace state; MindCloud retains policy, credentials and promotion authority
modules.security: Orca worktrees/processes are execution surfaces only; credentials, browser sessions and computer-use authority remain in explicit MindCloud execution domains; task completion does not itself imply worktree/process completion

modules.integration: typed MindCore capability adapter for init/build/ask/grep/map/viz; generated graph remains a local regenerable cache
modules.security: admin-gated execution; repository workspace is explicit

modules.integration: typed supervised capability for plan/research/script/render/validate; outputs become artifacts before promotion
modules.security: admin-gated execution; credentials stay in the execution domain

modules.integration: typed adapter around local stdio MCP/CLI operations for graph search, tracing, architecture, impact analysis and gated indexing
modules.security: local-only by default; explicit repository root and execution domain

modules.integration: typed external visualization adapter for cameras, flights, ships, infrastructure, events, markets and risk zones; future API/MCP connection is gated on official availability
modules.security: public-source data only; no credentialed scraping; API/MCP contract must be verified before automation

modules.integration: typed adapter boundary for Grounded API outputs such as SLAM, depth and hand-tracking data; feed validated spatial observations into OSIRIS Geo and ARGOS ATLAS
modules.security: endpoint and credentials are explicit deployment configuration; no undocumented API contract is assumed
